_about: Vietnamese land-use type codes (mã ký hiệu loại đất) as printed on land certificates, cadastral maps and land-use plans. `codes` follow Phụ lục II mục A of Thông tư 08/2024/TT-BTNMT (effective 2024-08-01, under Land Law 2024), as reproduced by the source below; English glosses are ours. `planning_symbols` are symbols seen on urban zoning maps (quy hoạch phân khu / 1/500) that are NOT cadastral codes; they are unsourced here and must be read against the legend of the specific plan. Used by vnrealty/infra/catalog.py for the `zoning` note convention.
circular: Thông tư 08/2024/TT-BTNMT, Phụ lục II mục A

planning_symbols._basis: unsourced: common on Đà Nẵng urban zoning maps but defined by each plan's legend, not by Thông tư 08/2024. Treat glosses as hints and read the plan's own legend.
